role.roleTitle: Predictive Maintenance Engineer, Wind Turbine Fleet Analytics

evidence.text: Deployed four gearbox and bearing failure models into the live scoring service of the fleet analytics platform over three years, releasing each through the platform team's release pipeline under my own release tickets.

Watched live alert precision against confirmed failures in the weekly review with the maintenance planners, and handled the production model incidents in that period, including two sensor feed drop-outs, with incident records in the platform incident log.

Watched live alert precision against confirmed failures in the weekly review with the maintenance planners, and handled the production model incidents in that period, including two sensor feed drop-outs, with incident records in the platform incident log.
Coordinated model releases with the platform team in the release review, recording in the release ticket which checks were mine and which belonged to the platform team.
Built and backtested each model on the historical sensor and work-order data under the evaluation protocol agreed with the planners before proposing it for release.
Wrote the model card for each model, listing the training data window, the backtest results, the known limitations for turbines without vibration sensors and the hand-over conditions.
